ns2:course.label: Professional Ethics in Education
ns2:course.description: An introduction to professional ethics for educators: helps students reflect on the values embedded in educational aims, the norms regulating educational practice, and the dispositions displayed by excellent practitioners. Same as EPS 410. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as EPS 410. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours.
